context.summary: Reviewing branch HEAD against 67359a5e from merge-base 67359a5ec9d8e87f5f6353e7a821866afc6256d8.

result.summary: No ship: the design overstates its protection against task notifications becoming skill learnings.

findings.title: [A/HEAVY] The learnings ledger can still authorize a notification-derived skill revision
findings.body: The spec says a candidate supported by a flagged notification cannot reach Tier 3, but its named residual leaves a separate path open. The ledger validator derives trust from raw `tool_result` roles and does not see the notification's projection flag. A notification inside a skill invocation window can therefore support a ledger entry declared `false` without the validator rejecting it. If that mistaken assertion persists across three sessions, the ledger can authorize a later skill-body revision. This requires the dream pass to misattribute support, but that is the trust error the new flag is meant to contain.
findings.recommendation: Carry notification provenance into the ledger's code-derived trust check, or narrow the Tier-3 protection claim and obtain an explicit owner ruling accepting this skill-revision path before dispatch.

next_steps: Resolve the ledger path and rerun the design gate before dispatch.
